name: Feature 5: mouse merge preview, level mismatch swap and battle

get_node('SummonManager').occupied_count() == 2 and get_node('SummonManager').mana == 25 and get_node('SummonManager').current_cost() == 35 and not get_node('World/DragController/Preview').visible
